meta.name: deploy-to-vercel
meta.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键将应用部署到 Vercel 并获取链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将应用快速部署到 Vercel 并获取预览链接
copy.tagline_en: Deploy your app to Vercel and get a live link with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy apps to Vercel and need instant preview URLs

howto.what: Claude 会检查项目是否已关联 Vercel、是否安装 CLI，然后选择最合适的方式部署到 Vercel，并返回预览链接。
howto.when: 当你要求部署应用，例如说“部署我的应用”、“部署并给我链接”、“把这个上线”或“创建预览部署”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 上。
say.note: Claude 会检查项目状态并选择最佳部署方式。

say.text: 部署当前文件夹到 Vercel，给我预览链接。

howto.what_en: Claude checks if the project is linked to Vercel and if the CLI is installed, then chooses the best method to deploy and returns a preview URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy an app, e.g., "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

say_en.note: Claude will check project state and choose the best method.

say_en.text: Deploy the current folder to Vercel and give me the preview link.
say_en.note: Claude will use CLI or no-auth script and return the URL.
